Validators evaluate submissions, maintain network integrity, and earn rewards proportional to their stake and evaluation accuracy.</p></div><div class="mt-4 border-t border-border/30 pt-4"><div class="mb-2 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground/70">How it works</div><div class="prose prose-sm dark:prose-invert max-w-prose text-foreground/70 leading-[1.7] prose-p:my-2"><p>RedTeam Subnet operates as a two-layer system: Miners develop and submit Docker-containerized solutions to challenges (stored privately on Docker Hub), reference commits via SHA256 digest in active_commit.yaml, and keep miner nodes running continuously. Validators run private infrastructure, evaluate submissions through scoring APIs, assign weights to miners based on performance, and maintain consensus. A central dashboard aggregates submission status, validation results, comparison logs, and scoring outcomes for miners.</p>
<p>Yuma Consensus aggregates validator evaluations weighted by stake to determine miner emissions. The 24-hour commit cooldown ensures fairness; submissions are encrypted initially then decrypted and scored after cooldown expires. Similarity checking prevents plagiarism by comparing submissions against accepted history plus same-day submissions.</p></div></div><div class="mt-4 border-t border-border/30 pt-4"><div class="mb-2 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground/70">Incentive mechanism</div><div class="prose prose-sm dark:prose-invert max-w-prose text-foreground/70 leading-[1.7] prose-p:my-2"><p>Validators assess miner submissions and assign weights (0.0-1.0). Yuma Consensus aggregates validator weights weighted by stake. Miners receive 41% of subnet emissions proportional to their performance ranking.</p>
<p>Validators receive 41% based on EMA bonds, and the subnet owner receives 18%. Submissions decay over 10-15 days, incentivizing continuous improvement. Similarity penalties reduce final scores; scores above acceptance thresholds with acceptable similarity earn rewards.</p>
<p>New submissions replace previous earnings immediately.</p></div></div><div class="mt-3 flex items-center gap-2 border-t border-border/30 pt-3"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24"
